# CANDIDATE: OPENING_RANGE_VOLUME_IMBALANCE_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-22  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Early morning volume-driven breaks of the opening range (first 30 minutes) signal institutional participation and tend to persist due to order flow imbalance. The volume imbalance condition (breakout bar volume >= 1.5x prior 20-bar average 5-minute volume) filters for high-conviction breaks, reducing false signals from low-volume gaps or chop.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** At 09:30 EST, compute opening range high (ORH) and low (ORL) from the first 30 minutes of RTH (09:30-10:00). When a 5-minute bar closes above ORH AND its volume is >= 1.5x the average volume of the prior 20 five-minute bars (i.e., bars from 08:55-09:25 EST, premarket excluded), go long at the close of that bar.  
**Exit:** Initial stop at ORL. TP1 at 1.5R (risk = entry - ORL). If price reaches 2R without hitting stop, trail the remaining position with a chandelier exit (ATR(2) x 3) to capture runners. Regime filters: only trade when VIX < 18, time between 09:30-10:30 EST, and opening range width < 0.5% of SPY price (avoid excessive gaps). Skip during major news windows (FOMC, CPI, NFP, mega-cap earnings).

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+ account; $1K paper account ~= 14% headline P&L (scales linearly with contracts).
2. **Sample bias:** No historical backtest performed; proposal based on theoretical edge. High overfit risk due to untested parameters (volume multiple, OR width filter, VIX threshold, time window).
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (no walk-forward or held-out window tested).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (no realistic simulation with OPRA bid/ask/slippage on anchor days).
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day: false break during choppy market (e.g., low volume, news spike) triggering entry then immediate reversal to ORL stop. Max drawdown scenario: consecutive losing days during high-VIX regime (VIX > 18) where filter fails to suppress entries. Blow-up scenario: gap open >0.5% OR width combined with volume imbalance false signal during FOMC/CPI, leading to large adverse move past ORL stop before news release.
6. **Concentration:** Unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest to determine if top-5 days drive X% of P&L.
